notes.title: [Synapse: Lockdown] Offline Alpha Test Demo Announcement
notes.content:
Hello,
This is Cresent, the development team behind [Synapse: Lockdown].

We are pleased to announce that from May 22 (Thu) to May 25 (Sun), 2025, we will be holding an offline alpha test demo for [Synapse: Lockdown] at 2025 PlayX4, held in South Korea.

This marks the first public reveal of our two-player multiplayer demo build, offering attendees an exclusive opportunity to experience key gameplay systems and core content ahead of release.
Please note that this demo will only be playable at the event and will not be available online or through external distribution.

[h3]Demo Information[/h3]
[list]
[*] Event: 2025 PlayX4
[*] Date: May 22 (Thu) - May 25 (Sun), 2025 (KST)
[*] Location: KINTEX Exhibition Center 1, Hall 4, E08 - Cresent (South Korea)
[/list]

Synapse: Lockdown is currently in development for the PC (Steam) platform.
Details regarding early access and development progress will be announced through our official channels in due course.

We look forward to meeting you in person at PlayX4 and hearing your valuable feedback.

Thank you.

-
The Synapse: Lockdown Development Team
